description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing 'workouts' in a fitness application. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and viewing the workout history, with role-based access control. It employs Pydantic models for request/response schemas and SQLAlchemy ORM models for data persistence. The file is core to the workout management features, with distinct routes for members, trainers, and admins.

classes.name: WorkoutCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new workout, including member ID, date, type, duration, and notes.

classes.name: WorkoutResponse
classes.description: Schema for responding with workout details.

classes.name: WorkoutListResponse
classes.description: Schema for paginated list responses containing workout items.

classes.name: WorkoutPatchRequest
classes.description: Schema for partially updating workout fields such as date, type, duration, and notes.

methods.name: WorkoutResponse _to_response(w: Workouts)
methods.description: Converts a Workouts ORM object into a WorkoutResponse schema.

methods.name: Users _ensure_user_exists(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID or raises a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: None _authorize_update(workout: Workouts, user: Users)
methods.description: Checks whether the current user is permitted to update a specific workout based on role and ownership.

methods.name: WorkoutResponse create_workout( payload: WorkoutCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create and assign a workout to a member, restricted to trainers and admins.

methods.name: WorkoutListResponse list_my_workouts( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), page: conint(ge=1) = Query(1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: conint(ge=1, le=100) = Query(20, description="Page size (1-100)"), from_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date >= from_date"), to_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date <= to_date"), )
methods.description: Lists current user's workouts with pagination and optional date filters.

methods.name: WorkoutListResponse list_member_workouts( user_id: int = Path(..., description="Member user id"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: conint(ge=1) = Query(1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: conint(ge=1, le=100) = Query(20, description="Page size (1-100)"), from_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date >= from_date"), to_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date <= to_date"), )
methods.description: Allows trainers and admins to list workouts for a specific member, with pagination and date filters.

methods.name: WorkoutListResponse workout_history( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), page: conint(ge=1) = Query(1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: conint(ge=1, le=100) = Query(20, description="Page size (1-100)"), from_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date >= from_date"), to_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Filter: date <= to_date"), )
methods.description: Provides workout history for current user, similar to list_my_workouts, emphasizing history view.

methods.name: WorkoutResponse patch_workout( id: int = Path(..., description="Workout ID"), payload: WorkoutPatchRequest = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Allows members to update their own workouts and trainers/admins to update any workout.
